scope: the open-source 3.3.3.3 server (enceka/cols) contains the authoritative field-stream decoder

repo.what: pure-Rust 3.3.3.3 server with native game channel, authoritative matches, snapshots and field tables

key_files.crates/protocol/src/game/snapshot/mod.rs: snapshot writer and the field-stream decoder

decoder_facts.last: r.bits(8) - 1: an 8-bit upper bound on the field index, not a count
decoder_facts.loop: while index < last: read distance (1 bit + optional 4-bit parts) then the codec value for fields[index]

codecs.-94: 1 bit (1) + u8 event id + optional parameter

mapping_to_our_findings.byte164: this is the 8-bit `last` field bound, not an entity count - writes of 1 mean last=0
mapping_to_our_findings.per-entity bit: there is no per-entity bit in this decoder; the loop is over field indices
mapping_to_our_findings.field table: 1649370's own table is at 0xDA63E8 and uses the same [offset, codec, hint] layout (first row: 76, -58, 0)

reuse_plan: port this decoder to Python and drive it against 1649370's table at 0xDA63E8
then encode one entity as: last(8) + distance/field pairs according to the table
start with eType (codec -77 raw byte) and the 16-bit position codec, as cols does for its local player
